skill.summary: Comprehensive security analysis and vulnerability assessment — threat modeling, secure code review, and pre-deployment security validation across application...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of snyk-hardened skill with comprehensive security and vulnerability assessment capabilities.

- Provides expert guidance on secure software development, advanced threat modeling, and security architecture.
- Supports multi-layer security assessment: application, cloud, container, IaC, open source dependencies, and AI/ML components.
- Implements a methodical workflow with authentication, scan sequencing, risk prioritization, and actionable remediation.
- Integrates advanced methodologies: MITRE ATT&CK mapping, CVSS/EPSS scoring, supply chain security, and architecture reviews.
- Delivers executive-ready reports with detailed findings, remediation steps, and compliance insights.
- Enforces strict security guardrails on Snyk organization data handling.
